svg.title: 05 matched pose futures
svg.desc: Synthetic opposite-direction trajectories meet at the same current pose and diverge in the future. History can resolve a state ambiguity.

rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1.2; fill: rgb(96%,97%,98%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: Similar current pose can conceal different futures
Teaching schematic: opposite velocities distinguish two histories that meet at the current state.

g.text: Match posture, view and support using the prefix; then evaluate the observed futures.
Within-recording contrasts may reduce appearance differences; cancellation must be tested.
All curves are synthetic illustrations. Real matched clips do not establish a causal intervention.
